rawFindings.title: Potential improper handling of 'this$N' properties in v1 decoder's readObject
rawFindings.explanation: The original code skips adding properties named like 'this$N' (eg. 'this$0'), which are often used for inner class references in Java. The patched code removes this filter and adds all properties regardless of name. This change can affect the object graph by including fields that previously were excluded, potentially affecting circular references or special fields behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the lines in readObject method at line 414 to reintroduce the regex check so that properties matching /^this\$\d+$/ are skipped when adding to result.$ to maintain previous behavior and avoid unintended reference additions.

rawFindings.title: Potential improper handling of 'this$N' properties in v2 decoder's readObject
rawFindings.explanation: Similar to v1 decoder, the v2 decoder previously skipped properties named like 'this$N' when reading an object, but the patch removes this filter and adds all properties regardless of name. This can change object deserialization behavior, possibly affecting special fields and references.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the lines in readObject method at line 587 to reintroduce the regex check so that properties matching /^this\$\d+$/ are skipped when adding to result.$ to maintain compatibility and expected behavior.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect skipping of 'this$<num>' properties in v1 decoder readObject method
rawFindings.explanation: In lib/v1/decoder.js, in the readObject method, the original code conditionally skipped storing properties whose keys match /^this\$\d+$/, but the patch removes this condition and stores all properties unconditionally. This change breaks the original behavior where such self-referential properties were intentionally omitted to avoid incorrect or circular references in the decoded object.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original conditional check to skip properties matching /^this\$\d+$/ when assigning to result.$ in lib/v1/decoder.js to maintain correct decoding behavior.

The patch removes this condition, causing all properties to be included, which deviates from the established behavior of skipping self-referential properties to prevent decoding issues.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the conditional logic to skip fields named /^this\$\d+$/ in lib/v2/decoder.js readObject method to ensure decoded objects correctly handle self-referential fields.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of property reading in v2 Decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: Similarly to the v1 decoder, the v2 decoder's readObject method conditionally assigned object properties excluding keys that match /^this\$\d+$/.
